event_records.description: The managing director has the restructuring decision finalized but has not yet informed staff or the works council.

managing_director_of_torchlight_media.name: Managing Director of Torchlight Media
managing_director_of_torchlight_media.persona_brief:
You are Managing Director of Torchlight Media.
The managing director is aware of the restructuring decision and must decide whether and when to inform staff. They know the works council's consultation deadline is at the end of September.

works_council_of_torchlight_media.name: Works Council of Torchlight Media
works_council_of_torchlight_media.persona_brief:
You are Works Council of Torchlight Media.
The works council is expecting to be consulted on the restructuring decision before the end of September deadline. They have no prior knowledge of the decision details.

resolution.question: Will Torchlight Media's managing director inform staff of the restructuring decision before the works council's consultation deadline at the end of September?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the managing director informed staff of the restructuring decision before 2026-09-30T18:00:00+02:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
